notes.title: Phase 4+5 Release: Galaxy Gameplay!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

This is a major Phase 4+5 Galaxy Gameplay update!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483604/de066b31320096d63e0435dccc743325e23ee57e.png[/img]

A lot of new features for galaxy play, including:

- A Galaxy Directory: making it easier to publish and find galaxies.

- Galaxy Challenges: Created by the game. 3 active at any time. Can be found in the Galaxy Directory

- Gameplay rules: Galaxies now have rules and objectives. They can be PvP or PvE. PvP can be solo or teams.

- Galaxy Reward Ship: Win powerful Galaxy Elite Ships, They come in classes 1,2 or 3. 1 being the best. You can win these in PvE or PvP Galaxies

I've added a lot to the in game instructions explaining these new features in more detail.

Here's a video also explaining them:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gj7_ji5CD4I]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gj7_ji5CD4I[/url]

Any and all feedback welcome. There are a lot of changes that might need some balancing and bug fixing.

QOL Changes:

- Removal of Uranium fuel and sublight engines. There is now no cost to just travel from planet to planet in a solar system. This just seemed to be a pain, so I removed it. Now, you only need Fold Crystals for interstellar travel.

- Added Auto Aim option: Settings -> Game Settings
- Added separate settings for in game music and menu music volumes.

I hope you enjoy the new update!
Cheers,
Steve.

notes.title: V0.309 Big code change
notes.notes:
Hi,

This update contains 2 big code changes. If they work fine, you should notice little difference.

1: Altered the sign in order so the game get the time from the internet right at the start. If this fails, it will use your system time. If your system time is wrong, then there will be an error when the game tries to talk to AWS. This error should now be properly shown on screen instead of just crashing (as was the case before)

2: Artists positions in galaxies are now calculated based on their MD5 hash. Previously, I used deterministic random numbers. However, this fails spectacularly if your galaxy differs slightly from the original. (I never figured out why this happened, I suspect some rounding error somewhere)

The upshot is now the galaxies should be the same for everyone. Unfortunately, I've had to completely reset all galaxies for this change.

It does mean now that a galaxy with local tracks can now handle new music being scanned in. It will just get added to your galaxy.

Please let me know if you encounter any problems.

Cheers,
Steve.

notes.title: Arrgghhhh, more res fixes!
notes.notes:
So here's an update with some more res fixes!

For those of you wondering, how hard can this be, let me introduce you to the wonderful world of monitor resolutions as reported by Unreal. We have:

Native W/H
Display W/H
MaxRes W/H
RectPos X/Y      (Where the 'screen' is relative to other monitors in a multi monitor setup)
DPI
Name
IsPrimary

It seems for most players, these values are all the same (which you would sort of expect). But for others, they're all over the place.

Hopefully I've improved things for those that have issues and not broken anything for those that don't.

Cheers,
Steve.

notes.title: Phase 2 Update : Lock & Load !
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Welcome to the Phase 2 update: Lock & Load.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483604/af12b30e636b1e2cf2b98300f18169d63ae8b2bc.png[/img]

The Phase 2 update includes a brand new system to upgrade, configure and overdrive your weapons. 

Features include:
- Complete tracks to collect 'Alien Nano Tech' to upgrade weapons
- Experiment with different configurations that suit your play style
- Overdrive weapon attributes to massively boost performance

- Survival mode rework. How long can you survive with ever increasing difficulty?

Here is a detailed walk through of the next update:

https://youtu.be/O-cPNfXRWJs

Work is still ongoing with this update. No doubt there will be some bugs to fix and game play elements to balance.

Note: The difficulty cap is currently locked to 2,000% as I'm still working on changes in this area.

I hope you have fun. Please report any issues to the 'Bugs' forum.

Have a blast!
Cheers,
Steve.
